answer: Each challenge is bound to a domain-separated commitment and a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS beacon pulse whose value is unknowable at issuance. Only after the unbiasable pulse can the task be instantiated and verified, so juniper, forge, and basalt agents cannot precompute answer tables, farm offline, or coordinate sybil identities; invalid or duplicated proofs are rejected, while quorum signatures prevent proposer manipulation.
